newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares to test 1,630 pts resistance-chartist.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares to test 1,630 pts resistance-chartist.

text.p: Investors with a short-term horizon should jump in to profit from a likely move of the Greek general index to around 1,630 points, said technical analyst Lia Kardara of Prognosis Investment Services in a report.
But investors with a medium- to long-term horizon should gradually rebalance their portfolios in favour of Greek equities at current price levels, the report said.

"In the near-term, the index will oscillate between its short-term resistance at 1,600-1,630 points and a support level validated at 1,530 points for as long as trading volume and volatility is low," said the report which was based on Wednesday's closing prices.
The brief encounter of the 1,530 support level might become the springboard for a rebound to 1,630 points.

"A short-term move to 1,630 points appears likely once the 1,550 points have been cleared," it said. "This is facilitated by the low supply of shares and signalled by short-term technical indicators."
Caution was warranted as regards the likelihood of a failure of the index to succesfully challenge resistance levels.
"Even though the odds favour the optimistic scenario, the index would drift all the way to 1,450 points should it penetrate downwards the 1,520 level," it said.
